files.Title: Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx.Attributes.BUTRUnsafeAccessorAttribute
files.Summary:
Marks a static stub method to provide direct access to private or internal members across assembly boundaries.

When the declaring assembly is registered, UIExtenderEx transpiles the stub's body to emit direct access IL bypassing runtime visibility checks. If the targeted member cannot be resolved, the stub retains its original placeholder body and logs a diagnostic warning.

Stub methods must provide a placeholder body (such as throw new NotImplementedException();) and should be decorated with [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)] to prevent call-site inlining prior to transpilation. Target resolution matches (or the stub method name if omitted), parameter types, and return type.

Modeled after .NET 8's System.Runtime.CompilerServices.UnsafeAccessorAttribute for compatibility with .NET Framework 4.7.2 and .NET 6.0 runtimes.

files.Title: Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx.Attributes.BUTRViewModelOverrideAttribute
files.Summary:
Marks a mixin method to intercept and override an instance method on the extended host ViewModel.

The override method signature must accept all parameters of the target host method, followed by an additional delegate parameter (original) matching the target method's parameter list. Calling original invokes the next chained override in registration order or the original host implementation once the chain completes. Omitting the invocation suppresses subsequent overrides and the original host method body.

Only instance methods returning void and containing no ref or out parameters can be intercepted. Overrides apply across all caller invocations (Gauntlet prefab command bindings, hotkeys, and direct engine calls) on ViewModel instances where the mixin is enabled.

files.Title: Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx.ResourceManager.BrushFactoryManager
files.Summary:
Manages runtime registration of custom instances across all active objects.

Registers brushes directly into the native factory lookup dictionary to prevent JIT inlining bypasses on GetBrush. Injects brushes into newly instantiated factories and handles cache invalidation across BrushFactory.LoadBrushes reloads.

files.Title: Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx.Runtimes.IPrefabRuntime
files.Summary:
Defines a movie loading strategy queried by UIExtenderEx prior to every UI movie load in GauntletMovie.Load.

Intended for runtime implementations rather than mod consumers. While mod extensions (prefab patches and ViewModel mixins) determine visual and logical structure across all runtimes, the active runtime controls execution strategy and performance without altering rendered content.

files.Title: Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx.Runtimes.PrefabRuntimes
files.Summary:
Coordinates registered prefab runtimes and exposes shared runtime capabilities.

When no runtimes are registered, all movies fall back to the native Gauntlet XML loader with all patches applied. Registered runtimes act strictly as performance optimizations, serving pre-compiled or dynamically compiled widget trees where applicable.

files.Title: Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx.Runtimes.PrefabSource
files.Summary:
Exposes patched prefab XML data, widget factory state, and lifecycle invalidation events consumed by prefab runtimes.

Events fire on the thread that triggered the underlying operation (typically the main engine UI thread, except when background compilation workers parse prefabs). Event handler exceptions are caught and logged without propagating into TaleWorlds engine calls.
